units.id: mission:remembrance day|log|28|0
units.english: The Alphas were designed hundreds of years ago as genetically engineered super-soldiers, with no compassion or empathy. They escaped from their masters, enslaved entire planets, and commanded massive fleets of ships. Eventually they were defeated, and were either killed or went into hiding. They can be recognized by their green, photosynthetic skin.
units.italian: Gli Alphas furono progettati secoli fa come super-soldati geneticamente modificati, privi di compassione e di empatia. Fuggirono dai loro padroni, resero schiavi interi pianeti e comandarono enormi flotte di navi. Alla fine furono sconfitti, e vennero uccisi o si nascosero. Si riconoscono dalla pelle verde, fotosintetica.

units.id: mission:remembrance day|Alphas can live for centuries, and it is likely that many of them have survived, hiding out on anarchist worlds or somewhere beyond human space. Fortunately, they reproduce much more slowly than ordinary humans do.|29|0
units.english: Alphas can live for centuries, and it is likely that many of them have survived, hiding out on anarchist worlds or somewhere beyond human space. Fortunately, they reproduce much more slowly than ordinary humans do.
units.italian: Gli Alphas possono vivere per secoli, ed è probabile che molti siano sopravvissuti, nascosti su mondi anarchici o da qualche parte oltre lo spazio umano. Per fortuna si riproducono molto più lentamente degli umani comuni.

units.id: mission:remembrance day|Today, throughout human space, is Remembrance Day, the anniversary of the beginning of the Alpha Wars more than five centuries ago. The Alphas were genetically engineered soldiers, with superhuman agility and intelligence, and a complete lack of compassion or empathy. At the height of the War, dozens of planets had been enslaved by the Alphas.|31|0
units.english: Today, throughout human space, is Remembrance Day, the anniversary of the beginning of the Alpha Wars more than five centuries ago. The Alphas were genetically engineered soldiers, with superhuman agility and intelligence, and a complete lack of compassion or empathy. At the height of the War, dozens of planets had been enslaved by the Alphas.
units.italian: Oggi, in tutto lo spazio umano, è il Giorno del Ricordo, l'anniversario dell'inizio delle guerre degli Alphas, più di cinque secoli fa. Gli Alphas erano soldati geneticamente modificati, con agilità e intelligenza sovrumane e una totale mancanza di compassione ed empatia. Al culmine della guerra, decine di pianeti erano stati resi schiavi dagli Alphas.

units.id: mission:remembrance day|	Remembrance Day commemorates the beginning of the war, rather than its end, as a perpetual reminder that the war is not over: although the Alphas were defeated, some of them escaped and remained in hiding, and they and their offspring are presumed to still be present in the galaxy today.|32|0
units.english: Remembrance Day commemorates the beginning of the war, rather than its end, as a perpetual reminder that the war is not over: although the Alphas were defeated, some of them escaped and remained in hiding, and they and their offspring are presumed to still be present in the galaxy today.
units.italian: Il Giorno del Ricordo commemora l'inizio della guerra, non la sua fine, come monito perpetuo che la guerra non è finita: sebbene gli Alphas siano stati sconfitti, alcuni fuggirono e restarono nascosti, e si presume che loro e la loro discendenza siano ancora presenti nella galassia oggi.

units.id: mission:remembrance day|	Since the Alpha War, genetic resequencing technology has been very tightly controlled. Because the Alphas were the product of experimental genetic manipulation rather than natural evolution, it is believed that their genes are less robust than true human beings, and they are almost unable to have viable offspring without access to special technology. Therefore, most Alpha enclaves that have been discovered since the War have had very small populations, no more than a few dozen.|33|0
units.english: Since the Alpha War, genetic resequencing technology has been very tightly controlled. Because the Alphas were the product of experimental genetic manipulation rather than natural evolution, it is believed that their genes are less robust than true human beings, and they are almost unable to have viable offspring without access to special technology. Therefore, most Alpha enclaves that have been discovered since the War have had very small populations, no more than a few dozen.
units.italian: Dalla guerra degli Alphas, la tecnologia di riordino genetico è stata controllata con grande severità. Poiché gli Alphas erano il prodotto di una manipolazione genetica sperimentale e non dell'evoluzione naturale, si ritiene che i loro geni siano meno robusti di quelli dei veri esseri umani, e che siano quasi incapaci di avere prole vitale senza accedere a tecnologie speciali. Per questo la maggior parte delle enclavi di Alphas scoperte dopo la guerra ha avuto popolazioni molto ridotte, non più di qualche decina di individui.

units.id: mission:remembrance day|	In these days when the Navy ensures peace throughout much of the galaxy, on many worlds the Alphas are treated as nothing more than a bogeyman story to frighten children. Because the most striking physical feature of the Alphas was their photosynthetic skin, on some worlds kids even run around wearing green face paint on Remembrance Day, trying to frighten people. But on other worlds, especially on the fringes of space where the Navy seldom patrols, the Alphas are still spoken of with fear.|34|0
units.english: In these days when the Navy ensures peace throughout much of the galaxy, on many worlds the Alphas are treated as nothing more than a bogeyman story to frighten children. Because the most striking physical feature of the Alphas was their photosynthetic skin, on some worlds kids even run around wearing green face paint on Remembrance Day, trying to frighten people. But on other worlds, especially on the fringes of space where the Navy seldom patrols, the Alphas are still spoken of with fear.
units.italian: In questi tempi in cui la Marina garantisce la pace in gran parte della galassia, su molti mondi gli Alphas non sono altro che una storia per spaventare i bambini. Poiché il tratto fisico più evidente degli Alphas era la pelle fotosintetica, su alcuni mondi i bambini corrono persino in giro con il viso dipinto di verde il Giorno del Ricordo, cercando di spaventare la gente. Ma su altri mondi, soprattutto ai margini dello spazio dove la Marina pattuglia di rado, degli Alphas si parla ancora con paura.

units.id: event:war begins|description|132|0
units.english: Until recently, Geminus was home to the Republic Navy Yard, the largest shipyard in human space. Now, there is nothing left of the shipyard but a gaping crater in the ground, from the recent terrorist bombing.
units.italian: Fino a poco tempo fa Geminus ospitava l'Arsenale della Marina della Repubblica, il più grande cantiere navale dello spazio umano. Ora dell'arsenale non resta altro che un cratere spalancato nel terreno, lasciato dal recente attentato terroristico.

units.id: event:war begins|spaceport|133|0
units.english: Fortunately, the spaceport and residential areas survived the bombing, which was focused only on the Navy Yard and happened early in the morning, when very few people were at work.
units.italian: Per fortuna lo spazioporto e le zone residenziali sono sopravvissuti all'attentato, che ha colpito solo l'Arsenale ed è avvenuto di prima mattina, quando pochissime persone erano al lavoro.

units.id: event:war begins|spaceport|134|0
units.english: The Navy officers who are in charge here have no time for anyone who is not enlisted in the Navy and participating in the ongoing investigation.
units.italian: Gli ufficiali della Marina che comandano qui non hanno tempo per chi non è arruolato nella Marina e non partecipa alle indagini in corso.

units.id: event:war begins|description|139|0
units.english: Martini is a world of exotic beaches and perfect weather. The Republic's central bank and the Galactic Stock Exchange were previously headquartered here, before a terrorist attack destroyed them and a large portion of the capital city as well.
units.italian: Martini è un mondo di spiagge esotiche e clima perfetto. Qui avevano sede la banca centrale della Repubblica e la Borsa Galattica, prima che un attacco terroristico le distruggesse insieme a gran parte della capitale.

units.id: event:war begins|description|140|0
units.english: Currently, a massive rescue and evacuation operation is underway in and around the capital to find and treat survivors and contain the radiation. As to be expected, the planet's supplies are running dangerously low, and what remains of Martini's government has called for civilian ships to help deliver goods and provisions for the operation.
units.italian: Al momento è in corso una massiccia operazione di soccorso e di evacuazione dentro e intorno alla capitale, per trovare e curare i sopravvissuti e contenere le radiazioni. Come prevedibile, le scorte del pianeta si stanno pericolosamente esaurendo, e quel che resta del governo di Martini ha chiesto alle navi civili di aiutare a consegnare beni e provviste per l'operazione.

units.id: event:war begins|spaceport|141|0
units.english: Instead of the immaculate spaceport that Martini once sported, this temporary spaceport consists of randomly-scattered makeshift landing areas, in order to support the large number of Navy and civilian ships assisting with the rescue and evacuation operation.
units.italian: Al posto dello spazioporto immacolato che Martini un tempo vantava, questo spazioporto temporaneo è fatto di piazzole di fortuna sparse alla rinfusa, per sostenere il gran numero di navi della Marina e civili che assistono alle operazioni di soccorso ed evacuazione.

units.id: event:war begins|description|145|0
units.english: Bourne is a well-developed industrial world that was first settled four centuries ago. Its cities are home to some of the richest individuals in this section of the galaxy, but also home to tens of thousands of homeless people, and many others whose factory jobs are barely providing enough to make ends meet.
units.italian: Bourne è un mondo industriale ben sviluppato, colonizzato per la prima volta quattro secoli fa. Le sue città ospitano alcuni degli individui più ricchi di questa parte della galassia, ma anche decine di migliaia di senzatetto e molte altre persone il cui lavoro in fabbrica basta a malapena a far quadrare i conti.

units.id: event:war begins|description|146|0
units.english: Outside the cities, the climate is somewhat dry, but the deep valleys and some coastal regions are suitable for farming. Very little of the planet remains that is untouched by human hands.
units.italian: Fuori dalle città il clima è piuttosto secco, ma le valli profonde e alcune zone costiere sono adatte all'agricoltura. Resta molto poco del pianeta che non sia stato toccato dalla mano dell'uomo.

units.id: event:war begins|description|147|0
units.english: Bourne is also the seat of government for the newly-formed Free Worlds.
units.italian: Bourne è anche la sede del governo dei Mondi Liberi, di recente formazione.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|log|158|0
units.english: The Free Worlds are a collection of local governments in the southern galactic arm who have declared independence from the Republic after Parliament refused to address issues they raised about trade tariffs, taxation, and representation. They may be linked to the recent terrorist attacks on the Navy Yard and the galactic stock exchange, although they deny responsibility.
units.italian: I Mondi Liberi sono un insieme di governi locali del braccio meridionale della galassia che hanno dichiarato l'indipendenza dalla Repubblica dopo che il Parlamento si è rifiutato di affrontare le questioni che avevano sollevato su dazi commerciali, tassazione e rappresentanza. Potrebbero essere legati ai recenti attentati terroristici all'Arsenale e alla borsa galattica, anche se negano ogni responsabilità.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|The moment you step off your ship you realize something is very wrong. The spaceport is eerily quiet, and a large crowd of people is gathered around a video screen in the local bar.|166|0
units.english: The moment you step off your ship you realize something is very wrong. The spaceport is eerily quiet, and a large crowd of people is gathered around a video screen in the local bar.
units.italian: Appena scendi dalla nave capisci che qualcosa non va affatto. Lo spazioporto è inquietantemente silenzioso, e una gran folla si è radunata attorno a uno schermo video nel bar locale.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	You ask what is happening, and someone explains. Recently, a collection of planetary governments in the southern galactic arm have sent the Republic what amounted to an ultimatum: a refusal to pay taxes until reforms are made in the election of planetary representatives. This group, calling itself the "Free Worlds," has also asked for immediate reevaluation of all existing trade tariffs and regulations concerning pilot registration. Parliament outright refused to consider any of these demands.|167|0
units.english: You ask what is happening, and someone explains. Recently, a collection of planetary governments in the southern galactic arm have sent the Republic what amounted to an ultimatum: a refusal to pay taxes until reforms are made in the election of planetary representatives. This group, calling itself the "Free Worlds," has also asked for immediate reevaluation of all existing trade tariffs and regulations concerning pilot registration. Parliament outright refused to consider any of these demands.
units.italian: Chiedi che cosa succede, e qualcuno te lo spiega. Di recente un insieme di governi planetari del braccio meridionale della galassia ha inviato alla Repubblica quello che equivale a un ultimatum: il rifiuto di pagare le tasse finché non saranno fatte riforme nell'elezione dei rappresentanti planetari. Questo gruppo, che si fa chiamare "Mondi Liberi", ha chiesto anche una rivalutazione immediata di tutti i dazi commerciali e delle norme sulla registrazione dei piloti. Il Parlamento ha rifiutato di prendere in considerazione una sola di queste richieste.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	Then, in the early morning, nuclear explosions on Geminus and Martini destroyed the Republic Navy Yard and the Galactic Stock Exchange, crippling the military and economic center of the Republic. The "Free Worlds" disclaim any responsibility for the attacks, despite the timing and the fact that the attacks serve their purposes very well.|168|0
units.english: Then, in the early morning, nuclear explosions on Geminus and Martini destroyed the Republic Navy Yard and the Galactic Stock Exchange, crippling the military and economic center of the Republic. The "Free Worlds" disclaim any responsibility for the attacks, despite the timing and the fact that the attacks serve their purposes very well.
units.italian: Poi, di prima mattina, esplosioni nucleari su Geminus e Martini hanno distrutto l'Arsenale della Marina della Repubblica e la Borsa Galattica, azzoppando il centro militare ed economico della Repubblica. I "Mondi Liberi" negano ogni responsabilità per gli attentati, nonostante i tempi e il fatto che questi servano molto bene ai loro scopi.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	Unless the terrorists can be found or turn themselves in, civil war is imminent. It has been less than a year since you bought your ship, and already the galaxy is falling apart on you.|169|0
units.english: Unless the terrorists can be found or turn themselves in, civil war is imminent. It has been less than a year since you bought your ship, and already the galaxy is falling apart on you.
units.italian: Se i terroristi non saranno trovati o non si consegneranno, la guerra civile è imminente. È passato meno di un anno da quando hai comprato la tua nave, e la galassia ti sta già crollando addosso.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	The moment you step off your ship you realize something is very wrong. Heavily armed Navy personnel flank either side of the spaceport building's exit, and more soldiers are patrolling the port. A liaison officer is herding a group of civilians toward a low bunker beside a nearby landing pad. On the landing pad itself, soldiers are struggling to set up a heavy plasma cannon mounted on an anti-aircraft turret.|175|0
units.english: The moment you step off your ship you realize something is very wrong. Heavily armed Navy personnel flank either side of the spaceport building's exit, and more soldiers are patrolling the port. A liaison officer is herding a group of civilians toward a low bunker beside a nearby landing pad. On the landing pad itself, soldiers are struggling to set up a heavy plasma cannon mounted on an anti-aircraft turret.
units.italian: Appena scendi dalla nave capisci che qualcosa non va affatto. Personale della Marina pesantemente armato fiancheggia l'uscita dell'edificio dello spazioporto, e altri soldati pattugliano il porto. Un ufficiale di collegamento sta radunando un gruppo di civili verso un bunker basso accanto a una piazzola vicina. Sulla piazzola stessa, i soldati faticano a installare un possente cannone al plasma montato su una torretta antiaerea.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	With the civilians safely in the bunker, the liaison officer turns to face you. "I'm sorry, Captain, but I'm going to have to ask you to leave the planet. We've got a Carrier squadron coming in, and we need all the pads free."|176|0
units.english: With the civilians safely in the bunker, the liaison officer turns to face you. "I'm sorry, Captain, but I'm going to have to ask you to leave the planet. We've got a Carrier squadron coming in, and we need all the pads free."
units.italian: Con i civili al sicuro nel bunker, l'ufficiale di collegamento si volta verso di te. "Mi dispiace, capitano, ma devo chiederti di lasciare il pianeta. Sta arrivando uno squadrone di navi portatrici e ci servono tutte le piazzole libere."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"Of course."|178|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"What's happening?"|180|0
units.english: "What's happening?"
units.italian: "Che succede?"

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"Is this some sort of training exercise?"|181|0
units.english: "Is this some sort of training exercise?"
units.italian: "È una specie di esercitazione?"

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"What makes you think you can just order me to leave?"|182|0
units.english: "What makes you think you can just order me to leave?"
units.italian: "E cosa ti fa pensare che tu possa solo ordinarmi di andarmene?"

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	The liaison officer sighs. "Captain, I'm afraid the planet is in a state of emergency. Yesterday, some rogue planets down south decided they wanted to secede from the Republic. Sent Parliament an ultimatum, wanted electoral and tax reform, free trade, all the same things they've been complaining about for years. No big deal. Three hours ago, though, the Navy Yard here on Geminus was bombed along with the Galactic Stock Exchange on Martini. We don't know if it's the work of the 'Free Worlds' rebels or not, and I can't promise you there aren't going to be more attacks. All I know is that whoever did this used nuclear weapons, so we've got three thousand injured people we need to get to off-planet medical care immediately."|185|0
units.english: The liaison officer sighs. "Captain, I'm afraid the planet is in a state of emergency. Yesterday, some rogue planets down south decided they wanted to secede from the Republic. Sent Parliament an ultimatum, wanted electoral and tax reform, free trade, all the same things they've been complaining about for years. No big deal. Three hours ago, though, the Navy Yard here on Geminus was bombed along with the Galactic Stock Exchange on Martini. We don't know if it's the work of the 'Free Worlds' rebels or not, and I can't promise you there aren't going to be more attacks. All I know is that whoever did this used nuclear weapons, so we've got three thousand injured people we need to get to off-planet medical care immediately."
units.italian: L'ufficiale di collegamento sospira. "Capitano, temo che il pianeta sia in stato di emergenza. Ieri alcuni pianeti ribelli del sud hanno deciso di voler secedere dalla Repubblica. Hanno mandato al Parlamento un ultimatum: volevano la riforma elettorale e fiscale, il libero scambio, tutte le stesse cose di cui si lamentano da anni. Niente di grave. Tre ore fa, però, l'Arsenale qui su Geminus è stato bombardato insieme alla Borsa Galattica su Martini. Non sappiamo se sia opera dei ribelli 'Mondi Liberi' o no, e non posso prometterti che non ci saranno altri attacchi. So solo che chiunque l'abbia fatto ha usato armi nucleari, quindi abbiamo tremila feriti da portare subito a cure mediche fuori dal pianeta."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"I'll get out of the way, then."|187|0
units.english: "I'll get out of the way, then."
units.italian: "Allora mi tolgo di mezzo."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"Sorry, I didn't know. I'll be out of your hair as soon as I can lift off."|189|0
units.english: "Sorry, I didn't know. I'll be out of your hair as soon as I can lift off."
units.italian: "Scusa, non lo sapevo. Ti lascio in pace appena riesco a decollare."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"Is there any way I can help?"|191|0
units.english: "Is there any way I can help?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa che posso fare per aiutare?"

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	As you descend towards the surface of Martini, you are met by an uncharacteristic layer of thick cloud, almost smoky in appearance. The clouds completely obscure Martini's main spaceport, as well as the rest of the capital city. Perhaps because of this, the landing controller instructs you to make your way to an auxiliary spaceport about ten kilometers from the city limits.|198|0
units.english: As you descend towards the surface of Martini, you are met by an uncharacteristic layer of thick cloud, almost smoky in appearance. The clouds completely obscure Martini's main spaceport, as well as the rest of the capital city. Perhaps because of this, the landing controller instructs you to make your way to an auxiliary spaceport about ten kilometers from the city limits.
units.italian: Mentre scendi verso la superficie di Martini, ti accoglie uno strato di nubi spesse e inconsuete, quasi fumose. Le nubi occultano completamente lo spazioporto principale di Martini, e anche il resto della capitale. Forse per questo il controllore di atterraggio ti ordina di dirigerti verso uno spazioporto ausiliario a una decina di chilometri dai confini della città.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	The moment you step off your ship you realize something is very wrong. Heavily armed Navy personnel flank either side of the spaceport building's exit, and more soldiers are patrolling the port. The main road to the city echoes with sirens, and a liaison officer is herding a group of civilians toward a military transport parked precariously in a nearby field. Still more people are stretched out on cots in a makeshift field hospital in the center of the spaceport.|199|0
units.english: The moment you step off your ship you realize something is very wrong. Heavily armed Navy personnel flank either side of the spaceport building's exit, and more soldiers are patrolling the port. The main road to the city echoes with sirens, and a liaison officer is herding a group of civilians toward a military transport parked precariously in a nearby field. Still more people are stretched out on cots in a makeshift field hospital in the center of the spaceport.
units.italian: Appena scendi dalla nave capisci che qualcosa non va affatto. Personale della Marina pesantemente armato fiancheggia l'uscita dell'edificio dello spazioporto, e altri soldati pattugliano il porto. La strada principale verso la città risuona di sirene, e un ufficiale di collegamento sta radunando un gruppo di civili verso un trasporto militare parcheggiato precariamente in un campo vicino. Altre persone ancora sono stese su brandine in un ospedale da campo improvvisato al centro dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	As soon as the last mobile civilian is safely aboard the transport, the liaison officer turns to face you. "I'm sorry, Captain, but I'm going to have to ask you to leave the planet. We've got another transport fleet coming in, and we need all the pads free."|200|0
units.english: As soon as the last mobile civilian is safely aboard the transport, the liaison officer turns to face you. "I'm sorry, Captain, but I'm going to have to ask you to leave the planet. We've got another transport fleet coming in, and we need all the pads free."
units.italian: Appena l'ultimo civile mobile è al sicuro sul trasporto, l'ufficiale di collegamento si volta verso di te. "Mi dispiace, capitano, ma devo chiederti di lasciare il pianeta. Sta arrivando un'altra flotta di trasporti e ci servono tutte le piazzole libere."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"Of course."|202|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"What's happening?"|204|0
units.english: "What's happening?"
units.italian: "Che succede?"

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"What makes you think you can just order me to leave?"|205|0
units.english: "What makes you think you can just order me to leave?"
units.italian: "E cosa ti fa pensare che tu possa solo ordinarmi di andarmene?"

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	The liaison officer sighs. "Captain, I'm afraid the planet is in a state of emergency. Yesterday, some rogue planets down south decided they wanted to secede from the Republic. Sent Parliament an ultimatum, wanted electoral and tax reform, free trade, all the same things they've been complaining about for years. No big deal. Three hours ago, though, someone - quite possibly this same 'Free Worlds' group - dropped a nuclear bomb on the Galactic Stock Exchange right here on Martini. At least, we presume that the Stock Exchange was their target, since the bomb took about a quarter of the city with it, as well as the main spaceport and half of the planet's medical resources. We've got more than a million injured people here and another five million we need to evacuate. To top it off, the terrorists also bombed the Navy Yard on Geminus, which means we don't have enough personnel available to both run the evacuation and deal with other civilians."|208|0
units.english: The liaison officer sighs. "Captain, I'm afraid the planet is in a state of emergency. Yesterday, some rogue planets down south decided they wanted to secede from the Republic. Sent Parliament an ultimatum, wanted electoral and tax reform, free trade, all the same things they've been complaining about for years. No big deal. Three hours ago, though, someone - quite possibly this same 'Free Worlds' group - dropped a nuclear bomb on the Galactic Stock Exchange right here on Martini. At least, we presume that the Stock Exchange was their target, since the bomb took about a quarter of the city with it, as well as the main spaceport and half of the planet's medical resources. We've got more than a million injured people here and another five million we need to evacuate. To top it off, the terrorists also bombed the Navy Yard on Geminus, which means we don't have enough personnel available to both run the evacuation and deal with other civilians."
units.italian: L'ufficiale di collegamento sospira. "Capitano, temo che il pianeta sia in stato di emergenza. Ieri alcuni pianeti ribelli del sud hanno deciso di voler secedere dalla Repubblica. Hanno mandato al Parlamento un ultimatum: volevano la riforma elettorale e fiscale, il libero scambio, tutte le stesse cose di cui si lamentano da anni. Niente di grave. Tre ore fa, però, qualcuno - molto probabilmente questo stesso gruppo dei 'Mondi Liberi' - ha sganciato una bomba nucleare sulla Borsa Galattica, proprio qui su Martini. Almeno, presumiamo che l'obiettivo fosse la Borsa, visto che la bomba ha portato via circa un quarto della città, oltre allo spazioporto principale e metà delle risorse mediche del pianeta. Abbiamo più di un milione di feriti e altri cinque milioni da evacuare. Per completare l'opera, i terroristi hanno bombardato anche l'Arsenale su Geminus, il che significa che non abbiamo abbastanza personale per gestire l'evacuazione e occuparci anche degli altri civili."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"I'll get out of the way, then."|210|0
units.english: "I'll get out of the way, then."
units.italian: "Allora mi tolgo di mezzo."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"Sorry, I didn't know. I'll be out of your hair as soon as I can lift off."|212|0
units.english: "Sorry, I didn't know. I'll be out of your hair as soon as I can lift off."
units.italian: "Scusa, non lo sapevo. Ti lascio in pace appena riesco a decollare."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"Is there any way I can help?"|214|0
units.english: "Is there any way I can help?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa che posso fare per aiutare?"

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"Look, Captain. The government here on <planet> has declared a state of emergency, and that means that the spaceport is under martial law. I'm not sure how you managed to get landing clearance, but you shouldn't be here. We've got thousands of injured people to get off-planet, even if we ignore the potential for a major follow-up attack. If you refuse to comply, I will have you arrested by the military police, and your ship will be impounded. If your crew refuses to accept the change in captainship, they will be replaced by troops from the Naval Reserve Command. Think what you will, but we've got human lives to save here and we aren't going to stop just because some hotshot captain is feeling full of themself. Is that clear?"|218|0
units.english: "Look, Captain. The government here on <planet> has declared a state of emergency, and that means that the spaceport is under martial law. I'm not sure how you managed to get landing clearance, but you shouldn't be here. We've got thousands of injured people to get off-planet, even if we ignore the potential for a major follow-up attack. If you refuse to comply, I will have you arrested by the military police, and your ship will be impounded. If your crew refuses to accept the change in captainship, they will be replaced by troops from the Naval Reserve Command. Think what you will, but we've got human lives to save here and we aren't going to stop just because some hotshot captain is feeling full of themself. Is that clear?"
units.italian: "Ascolta, capitano. Il governo qui su <planet> ha dichiarato lo stato di emergenza, e questo significa che lo spazioporto è sotto legge marziale. Non so come tu abbia fatto a ottenere l'autorizzazione all'atterraggio, ma non dovresti essere qui. Abbiamo migliaia di feriti da portare fuori dal pianeta, anche ignorando la possibilità di un grande attacco di ritorsione. Se rifiuti di obbedire, ti farò arrestare dalla polizia militare e la tua nave sarà sequestrata. Se il tuo equipaggio rifiuterà il cambio di comando, sarà sostituito da truppe del Comando della Riserva Navale. Pensa quello che vuoi, ma qui abbiamo delle vite umane da salvare e non ci fermeremo solo perché un capitano presuntuoso si sente tanto importante. È chiaro?"

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"Yes, that's clear."|220|0
units.english: "Yes, that's clear."
units.italian: "Sì, è chiaro."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"Sorry, I didn't know. You won't have any trouble from me."|222|0
units.english: "Sorry, I didn't know. You won't have any trouble from me."
units.italian: "Scusa, non lo sapevo. Non avrai problemi da me."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"Yeah, right. No way are you going to seize my ship."|224|0
units.english: "Yeah, right. No way are you going to seize my ship."
units.italian: "Certo, come no. Non ti azzarderai a sequestrare la mia nave."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	The liaison officer glowers at you, then turns and signals to another soldier. Military police officers in full combat gear materialize behind you, grabbing you by the arms and handcuffing you tightly. As you're frogmarched toward a waiting bunker, you watch as the <ship> lifts off without you, leaving you stranded here. In the bunker, one of the soldiers who arrested you frisks you, seizing your pilot's license and handing it to a sergeant who stamps the words "Permanently Revoked" across it. With those two words, you are barred from space forever. It has been less than a year since you bought your ship, and already you have lost the right to use it as the galaxy falls apart on you.|226|0
units.english: The liaison officer glowers at you, then turns and signals to another soldier. Military police officers in full combat gear materialize behind you, grabbing you by the arms and handcuffing you tightly. As you're frogmarched toward a waiting bunker, you watch as the <ship> lifts off without you, leaving you stranded here. In the bunker, one of the soldiers who arrested you frisks you, seizing your pilot's license and handing it to a sergeant who stamps the words "Permanently Revoked" across it. With those two words, you are barred from space forever. It has been less than a year since you bought your ship, and already you have lost the right to use it as the galaxy falls apart on you.
units.italian: L'ufficiale di collegamento ti lancia un'occhiataccia, poi si volta e fa cenno a un altro soldato. Agenti della polizia militare in tenuta da combattimento completa ti appaiono alle spalle, ti afferrano per le braccia e ti ammanettano stretto. Mentre ti portano via a forza verso un bunker, vedi la <ship> decollare senza di te e lasciarti bloccato qui. Nel bunker uno dei soldati che ti hanno arrestato ti perquisisce, ti sequestra la licenza di pilota e la consegna a un sergente che vi appone il timbro "Revocata in via definitiva". Con quelle due parole, ti è vietato lo spazio per sempre. È passato meno di un anno da quando hai comprato la tua nave, e hai già perso il diritto di usarla mentre la galassia ti crolla addosso.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"Glad to hear it," they reply, turning to calm a group of hysterical Paradisians.|230|0
units.english: "Glad to hear it," they reply, turning to calm a group of hysterical Paradisians.
units.italian: "Ne sono felice", rispondono, voltandosi a calmare un gruppo di Paradisiani isterici.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	Re-entering the <ship>, you take off and head for orbit, narrowly missing the Carrier squadron mentioned by the liaison officer. Only then do you see that you've left the video screen in your ship on, playing footage almost identical to what you saw on the ground not long ago. According to the newscaster, this debacle was all started yesterday, when a group of planets in the south of the galaxy sent the Republic Parliament an ultimatum: a refusal to pay taxes until reforms are made in the election of planetary representatives. This group, calling itself the "Free Worlds," has also asked for immediate reevaluation of all existing trade tariffs and regulations concerning pilot registration. Parliament outright refused to consider any of these demands.|231|0
units.english: Re-entering the <ship>, you take off and head for orbit, narrowly missing the Carrier squadron mentioned by the liaison officer. Only then do you see that you've left the video screen in your ship on, playing footage almost identical to what you saw on the ground not long ago. According to the newscaster, this debacle was all started yesterday, when a group of planets in the south of the galaxy sent the Republic Parliament an ultimatum: a refusal to pay taxes until reforms are made in the election of planetary representatives. This group, calling itself the "Free Worlds," has also asked for immediate reevaluation of all existing trade tariffs and regulations concerning pilot registration. Parliament outright refused to consider any of these demands.
units.italian: Rientri nella <ship>, decolli e ti dirigi in orbita, mancando per un soffio lo squadrone di navi portatrici di cui parlava l'ufficiale. Solo allora ti accorgi di aver lasciato acceso lo schermo video nella nave, che trasmette immagini quasi identiche a quelle che hai visto a terra poco fa. Secondo il giornalista, tutto questo disastro è cominciato ieri, quando un gruppo di pianeti del sud della galassia ha inviato al Parlamento della Repubblica un ultimatum: il rifiuto di pagare le tasse finché non saranno fatte riforme nell'elezione dei rappresentanti planetari. Questo gruppo, che si fa chiamare "Mondi Liberi", ha chiesto anche una rivalutazione immediata di tutti i dazi commerciali e delle norme sulla registrazione dei piloti. Il Parlamento ha rifiutato di prendere in considerazione una sola di queste richieste.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	Then, only hours before you landed, nuclear explosions on Geminus and Martini destroyed the Republic Navy Yard and the Galactic Stock Exchange, crippling the military and economic center of the Republic. The "Free Worlds" disclaim any responsibility for the attacks, despite the timing and the fact that the attacks serve their purposes very well.|232|0
units.english: Then, only hours before you landed, nuclear explosions on Geminus and Martini destroyed the Republic Navy Yard and the Galactic Stock Exchange, crippling the military and economic center of the Republic. The "Free Worlds" disclaim any responsibility for the attacks, despite the timing and the fact that the attacks serve their purposes very well.
units.italian: Poi, solo poche ore prima del tuo atterraggio, esplosioni nucleari su Geminus e Martini hanno distrutto l'Arsenale della Marina della Repubblica e la Borsa Galattica, azzoppando il centro militare ed economico della Repubblica. I "Mondi Liberi" negano ogni responsabilità per gli attentati, nonostante i tempi e il fatto che questi servano molto bene ai loro scopi.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	Unless the terrorists can be found or turn themselves in, civil war is imminent. It has been less than a year since you bought your ship, and already the galaxy is falling apart on you.|233|0
units.english: Unless the terrorists can be found or turn themselves in, civil war is imminent. It has been less than a year since you bought your ship, and already the galaxy is falling apart on you.
units.italian: Se i terroristi non saranno trovati o non si consegneranno, la guerra civile è imminente. È passato meno di un anno da quando hai comprato la tua nave, e la galassia ti sta già crollando addosso.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	The liaison officer responds with a curt thank-you and turns around to calm a hysterical Paradisian. You re-enter the <ship>, and prepare to take off. It has been less than a year since you bought your ship, and already the galaxy is falling apart on you.|237|0
units.english: The liaison officer responds with a curt thank-you and turns around to calm a hysterical Paradisian. You re-enter the <ship>, and prepare to take off. It has been less than a year since you bought your ship, and already the galaxy is falling apart on you.
units.italian: L'ufficiale di collegamento risponde con un ringraziamento secco e si volta a calmare un Paradisiano isterico. Rientri nella <ship> e ti prepari a decollare. È passato meno di un anno da quando hai comprato la tua nave, e la galassia ti sta già crollando addosso.

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	"Yes. You can take off like I asked you to." The officer pauses. "Sorry, Captain, but that's the truth. The Navy has personnel trained for responding to nuclear disasters, and all you'd be doing here right now is taking up space. If you really want to help, you're better off waiting a day for us to properly coordinate a disaster response plan with the neighboring planets and their job boards."|241|0
units.english: "Yes. You can take off like I asked you to." The officer pauses. "Sorry, Captain, but that's the truth. The Navy has personnel trained for responding to nuclear disasters, and all you'd be doing here right now is taking up space. If you really want to help, you're better off waiting a day for us to properly coordinate a disaster response plan with the neighboring planets and their job boards."
units.italian: "Sì. Puoi decollare come ti ho chiesto." L'ufficiale fa una pausa. "Scusa, capitano, ma è la verità. La Marina ha personale addestrato a rispondere ai disastri nucleari, e tutto quello che faresti qui adesso è occupare spazio. Se vuoi davvero aiutare, faresti meglio ad aspettare un giorno che coordiniamo per bene un piano di risposta al disastro con i pianeti vicini e le loro bacheche degli incarichi."

units.id: mission:event: war begins|	The officer turns around, interrupted by the shrieks of a panicked Paradisian. You re-enter the <ship>, and prepare to take off.|242|0
units.english: The officer turns around, interrupted by the shrieks of a panicked Paradisian. You re-enter the <ship>, and prepare to take off.
units.italian: L'ufficiale si volta, interrotto dalle strida di un Paradisiano nel panico. Rientri nella <ship> e ti prepari a decollare.
